DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

Given the MRI findings of non-enhancing demyelinating lesions consistent with PML and normal blood work, this is an opportunistic infection typically caused by the JC virus in immunocompromised patients. Have you been diagnosed with HIV, or are you currently taking medications that suppress your immune system, such as rituximab or natalizumab?
